verses.1: And the leaders of the fathers came to the family of Benjamin, son of Makir, son of Manasseh, from the families of Joseph. They spoke before Moses and before the elders of Israel.
verses.2: And they said, “Your Lord has commanded that the land be given as a inheritance to the children of Israel. Your Lord also commanded that the inheritance of Zelphachad be given to our descendants.”
verses.3: And they became one of the tribes of the Israelites. Their women were taken away from us, and their inheritance was taken away from our ancestors. Their inheritance replaced our inheritance.
verses.4: And if the land becomes part of the children of Israel, and their territory expands beyond the territory of the Metochi that will be given to them, then their territory will overlap with the territory of our ancestors’ Metochi.
verses.5: And Moses commanded the children of Israel by the word of the LORD, saying, “Thus shall you take away the words of Joshua.”
verses.6: This is what the LORD commanded: “That what is good in their eyes should be considered as women’s property. But for the family of Mattah, their mother’s family, it should still be considered as women’s property.”
verses.7: And no one shall be allowed to take a portion of land from one tribe to another tribe. For those who belong to one tribe’s territory will continue to live there, just as their ancestors did.
verses.8: And every daughter who inherits a inheritance from the tribes of Israel, from one of her father’s family, shall become a wife. In this way, the children of Israel can inherit their fathers’ inheritance.
verses.9: And no one shall transfer a field from one place to another. For in each person’s own land, the stakes of Israel must remain firmly planted there.
verses.10: Just as Jehovah commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelphahad.
verses.11: And there arose a disease among their daughters: they became sick, deformed, and ugly. Their daughters became like the daughters of Tzalfhad; they became women who were not worthy of being called women at all.
verses.12: The daughters of Menashe ben Yosef became women. Their inheritance was assigned to the family of Abihen.
verses.13: These are the commandments and laws that Yahweh commanded Moses to give to the children of Israel during the night before Moab’s destruction on the banks of the Jordan River.
